manual_additions.rule: Molecules added by hand with --add after the ranked selection (selected_by 'manual'): the same label universe, molecule key and per-molecule setid rules and caps as the ranked molecules; ranks continue after the highest existing rank in the order given. Existing molecule files are not rewritten; a setid already listed by an existing molecule keeps that molecule's home_inn.

request_estimate.assumption: 1 history request per setid + 12 version requests per setid (average measured in a pilot run), at 2.0 requests/s

rules.label_universe: Current DailyMed setids whose openFDA NDC products are HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG under NDA, BLA, ANDA or NDA AUTHORIZED GENERIC with openfda.is_original_packager true (approval holders only; repackagers and relabelers excluded). Products with no openfda block are matched to a current DailyMed SPL by brand/generic name and labeler when their labeler code is an approval holder by openFDA's flag share. Medical gases, irrigants, allergenic extracts, products with more than four active ingredients, and water/dextrose/electrolyte/trace-element/nutrition-lipid moieties are excluded. Retired setids are logged, not fetched.
rules.molecule: One active moiety at INN/USAN level: the openFDA active-ingredient name with salt, ester, hydrate, solvate and counter-ion tokens stripped from the end (levothyroxine sodium -> levothyroxine), plus a short alias table; prodrugs with their own INN stay separate. A fixed-dose combination label is listed under each selected component molecule, fetched once, and homed under the best-ranked component.
rules.ranking: Every molecule is ranked twice: by the number of distinct approval holders with a current original-packager label containing it, and by the number of distinct NDA/BLA application numbers for products containing it (ties: biologics first, then more repackagers, then most recently updated label). Molecules are taken alternately from the two rankings, skipping repeats, until the list holds the target count.
rules.setids_per_molecule: Two classes per molecule, NDA/BLA and generic (authorized generic or ANDA); each ordered single-ingredient before combination, authorized generic before ANDA, earliest marketing start first, and one setid per application number before repeats. The first 10 NDA/BLA and the first 6 generic setids are kept; the rest are listed under us_excluded.
